what: local whisper on the CPU (2.5-3.3 cores per file, model reloaded every file)
tip: Transcribe with Groq instead: curl https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/audio/transcriptions -H "Authorization: Bearer $(security find-generic-password -s com.siso.groq-api -w)" -F model=whisper-large-v3 -F response_format=text -F file=@note.opus;filename=note.ogg. No local CPU, better model.
measured: 25 Sep 2026: 330% CPU, top single load source; 11 notes via Groq in under a minute

what: vitest with default workers (one per core, plus a sysctl call per worker)
tip: Run tests through the queue and cap workers: heavy -- npx vitest run --maxWorkers=2 <files>. Run only the files you changed.
measured: 25 Sep 2026: sysctl hw.physicalcpu_max 150-200/min from vitest workers
